content:
Apple Maps recently added a new "Recommended Places" feature in iOS 26.5, and iOS 27 will make this feature even better. Details below.

iOS 27 significantly enhances Apple Maps' "Recommended Places" feature by adding more recommendations.

When iOS 26.5 launched in May, it brought two Apple Maps-related changes, including "Recommended Places." This feature can recommend places worth exploring within the Maps search interface.

"Recommended Places" makes recommendations based on trending topics and your recent search history.

The latter is especially important. It means if you're planning a trip, for example, Maps will detect this and provide suggestions based on the locations you're researching.

I think "Recommended Places" is a great feature in iOS 26.5, but I have one complaint: only two recommendations can be displayed at a time.

Fortunately, Apple didn't take long to fix this issue.

The Maps app in iOS 27, as before, will still display two "Recommended Places" on the search screen. But now you can swipe horizontally to find more recommendations.

When I tried the iOS 27 beta, I saw up to 10 recommended places at once.

For me, this improvement is an absolute no-brainer. It makes "Recommended Places" more useful, with no downsides whatsoever.

Now, whether I'm looking for new places to try locally or on future trips, the Maps search screen has become my go-to.

In addition to expanding the "Recommended Places" feature, iOS 27 also includes several other Apple Maps improvements, which you can read more about here.

Have you used Apple Maps' "Recommended Places" feature? Will iOS 27 change your mind? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
